description:
Compare two or more instances of one convention side by side (0.63.0): for each dimension of the frame,
        each one's value, and whether they agree. Where they agree there is nothing to decide; what differs is the
        point of contention. refs: `<workspace_id>/<path>[@<receipt>]` (listings, deliveries, project or team files,
        a file at a cited save), or convention names with frame 'convention' (deciding a frame), or plain values with
        a frame. The frame is inferred when every ref names the same convention. With `dimensions`, only those rows.
        Use it to frame a decision file (/docs/decisions); hashn compares, it never picks.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

dimensions.description: Optional: compare on these dimensions only, e.g. a child decision's proposed children.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

frame.description: The convention every ref is an instance of (or 'convention' to compare conventions). Omit to infer it when all refs name the same convention.
frame.title: Frame

refs.description: Two to twelve things to compare: '<workspace_id>/<path>' (optionally '@<receipt>' for a cited save), convention names when frame is 'convention', or plain values with a frame.
refs.title: Refs

name: compare_instances
